source: Ballotpedia (ballotpedia.org) — Tier 2 corroboration source; acknowledged as a source per founder, 2026-09-22

pages_consulted.note: Carries the County Commission general-election and primary tables (Districts 1, 3, 5, 7) plus Soil & Water and judicial offices. Does not carry school board.
Carries School Board Districts 2, 4 and 6 At-large (general + nonpartisan primary).

County overview. Its 'County elections and candidates' Nov 3 section lists only Board of Commissioners Districts 5 and 7 (At-large) and Soil & Water Seats 1 and 5; Districts 1 and 3 are absent from this page and appear only on the municipal page. Its school board section lists Districts 2 and 6 At-large under Nov 3 and District 4 only under the Aug 18 primary.

method_notes: Pages fetched live via Firecrawl (maxAge 0, markdown, onlyMainContent), one Ballotpedia request at a time to honor Crawl-delay: 2. Only the Nov 3 general-election field was extracted; primary fields were read only to establish incumbency and to explain who advanced. Ballotpedia party labels were mapped to our codes for comparison (Democratic->DEM, Republican->REP, Nonpartisan->''). Incumbent flag taken from Ballotpedia's '(i)' marker / 'Incumbent' wording / bold-underline convention. No write-in candidates were listed on any page consulted. Two non-Ballotpedia search snippets (Hillsborough SOE candidate list, Florida Politics) are cited in notes as corroborating context only; they were not scraped and are not the source of record here. Read-only: no database or other repo files were modified.

DISCREPANCY on the Democratic nominee. Ballotpedia's general-election table lists Aileen Rodriguez (D) vs. incumbent Joshua Wostal (R) (i). Its primary table shows Rodriguez defeated Cindy Stuart in the Aug 18 Democratic primary. Adam Hattersley does not appear anywhere on the municipal page, the county overview page (which also lists Rodriguez vs. Wostal under 'Board of Commissioners District 7 At-large'), or the school-board page. Corroborating context from a firecrawl_search (not scraped, not Ballotpedia): the Hillsborough SOE 'Local Candidates & Committees' snippet (https://www.votehillsborough.gov/202/Local-Candidates-Committees) lists 'Adam Hattersley (DEM) - Inactive' and 'Aileen Rodriguez (DEM) - Qualified', and Florida Politics reported 'Adam Hattersley suspends campaign for Hillsborough County Commission' (https://floridapolitics.com/archives/758385-adam-hattersley-suspends-campaign-for-hillsborough-county-commission/). Our row for Hattersley still shows ballot_status 'ballot' / qualifying_status 'qualified', which looks stale. Reported only; not corrected (Tier 2).

Exact match. Ballotpedia: 'Brittany Lyssy (Nonpartisan) and Daniela Simic (Nonpartisan) are running in the general election ... on November 3, 2026'; 'There are no incumbents in this race.' Both advanced from the Aug 18 nonpartisan primary (Simic 38.7%, Lyssy 36.8%), defeating Chris Taylor (24.4%). Same pair listed on the county overview page.

DECIDED per both sources, but they name DIFFERENT people. Ballotpedia: 'The general election scheduled for November 3, 2026, was canceled.' and 'The primary scheduled for August 18, 2026, was canceled. Incumbent Patricia Rendon (Nonpartisan) won election in the primary for Hillsborough County Public Schools Board of Education District 4 without appearing on the ballot.' The county overview page likewise lists only Patricia Rendon for District 4, under the Aug 18 primary. Ashley Meeder does not appear on any Ballotpedia page consulted. Ours has Ashley Meeder as the single 'unopposed' candidate and does not list Rendon at all. Corroborating context from a firecrawl_search (not scraped, not Ballotpedia): the Hillsborough SOE candidate-list snippet (https://www.votehillsborough.gov/202/Local-Candidates-Committees) shows 'Office: School Board Member, Dist. 4. Ashley Meeder. status (Inactive-Withdrawn)'. So Ballotpedia agrees with us that this seat is decided and off the November ballot (consistent with F.S. 101.151(7)), but attributes it to Rendon, and our Meeder row looks stale (withdrawn candidate recorded as the unopposed winner). Reported only; not corrected (Tier 2).

Both candidates match. Name-form variant only: ours carries the nickname in quotes ('Kenneth "Ken" Gay'); Ballotpedia lists 'Kenneth Gay' (https://ballotpedia.org/Kenneth_Gay). Treated as a loose match. Ballotpedia marks Karen Perez as incumbent (bold/underline convention; 'Incumbent Karen Perez'). Page-internal labeling quirk on Ballotpedia: the section heading reads '### District 5' but every table and sentence beneath it says 'District 6 At-large'; the county overview page confirms 'Board of Education District 6 At-large' with the same two candidates. Ambiguity noted, not resolved here.
